Choose the build whose data matches the installed packages

Source: R/testdata.R
dot-testdata_select.Rd

Lookup rule:

Usage

.testdata_select(index, installed)

Arguments

index

list Output of .testdata_parse_index().

installed

list Output of package_versions() for index$packages.

Value

list with build (one row of index$builds) and match ("exact" or "filtered").

Details

  1. Exact: the installed packages' inputs_hash matches a build.

  2. Otherwise, filter builds package by package (in index$packages order):

    • not installed: no filter;

    • installed RemoteSha that appears in the index: same remote_sha;

    • otherwise (no RemoteSha, or an unbuilt one): same version, or if none of the remaining builds has it, version <= the installed one.

  3. Newest built_at among the survivors. Error if none survive.
